test_title: PYST 60: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given Venn diagram and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18b1ed28acc1bd012d5752cae2c8ebb71d1eb4f400ab1ae52a873c455ec70fcb.png] 

How many women are either smart or brave or both?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cadc86a84e4c9873d58d0209101b6967ddae07a4129d2d428b05632a9748150.png] 

The shaded region represents the number of women who are either smart or brave or both.

So, the number of women who are either smart or brave or both = 13 + 14 + 3 → 30

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
